Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Dinesh Chandra Gahatori, 
Advocate, for the appellants.
Mr. M.S. Bisht, Brief Holder, for the 
State.
This is an admitted First Appeal 
under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition 
Act, in which the Registry has reported that 
the paper book has already been prepared, 
but the parties to the First Appeal have not 
yet collect the same from the Registry.
Learned counsel for the parties to 
the First Appeal may collect their respective 
paper book from the Registry on payment of 
the usual charges.
List this First Appeal, as soon as the 
paper book is supplied to the learned 
counsel for the parties to the First Appeal.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 18.08.2022
Mahinder/
